description:
Gamille 3.0 Women Mountain Bike

Step-thru Frame - Easy for ladies and short rider to get on and off the bike.
Dual Disc Brakes - Fully ensure the safety of the ride.

Lockable Suspension Fork - Smoother and more efficient riding experience.
Professional Drivetrain - Provides precise, fast and varied shifting.

Designed for Female

This step-through design for lower standover height allows shorter riders to straddle their bike more easily and be convenient to ride in skirt. The special geometry of the steel frame was developed for women, with a special top tube and small frame ideally suited for women.

Hiland mountain bike with hi-ten steel frame that has good durability. It is strong enough and shock resistant for a comfortable ride. Internal shift cable and brake hose routing can last longer by protecting them from any environment.

Reliable Security

Dual mechanical disc brakes provide you better durability and stopping power. Also, it does not damage the rim.

XC tires are made of non-slip and explosion-proof materials, which has strong grip and puncture resistance.

Professional Drivetrain

Shimano 21-speed drivetrain provides precise and quick shifting with a wide range of gearing, so you always have the right gear for your terrain to enjoy riding.

Front suspension fork absorbs any bumps and dips encountered on your path. When ride on flat road, you can lock suspension fork to reduce absorbing pedaling power. Therefore, lockable suspension forks help cyclists ride efficiently and effortlessly over varied terrain.

Assembly & Guide

85% pre-assembled and easy to assemble within 25 minutes.

The delivery box includes free installation tools, pedals and kickstand. Click on the video to see an instructional video on assembly.

Step-thru Frame

Hiland hi-ten frame is lower so it's easier for ladies and short riders to stand over and hop on and off.

Dual Disc Brakes

Dual disc brakes provide better speed control and ensure full control in every situation. Also, it does not damage the rim.

Shimano 21-Speeds

Shimano 3*7 drivetrain provides precise and quick shifting, which gives you more control for climbing, descents and corners to enjoy riding.

XC Tire

XC tires are made of non-slip and explosion-proof materials. It has strong grip and puncture resistance. Dual-wall rims allow them to withstand high-intensity riding and protect the inner tube from rupture.

Master any trail with the Hiland Gamille 3.0 Women's Mountain Bike. Featuring a step-thru aluminum frame, Shimano 21-speed drivetrain, and lockout suspension for ultimate efficiency.
